model.title: Expanded Consular Fellows Act of 2026
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Jacky Rosen (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would allow the Secretary of State to extend temporary consular appointments to up to eight years, with the possibility of adding two more years if the Foreign Service needs it.
